name: ES Futures: 1-Hour Post Economic Event Reaction Study
description: Analyzes E-mini S&P 500 (ES) price behavior in the 1 hour following 6 major macro events: CPI, PPI, NFP, FOMC decisions, GDP releases, and Retail Sales. For each event type, measures the open-to-close return of the post-release 1-hour window. Produces a summary table (avg, median, win rate, avg abs move, count by event type), bar chart of average returns, time-scattered individual event moves, distribution histograms, and headline cards. Last 5 years of daily data.
source:
# =============================================================================
# ES FUTURES: 1-HOUR POST ECONOMIC EVENT REACTION STUDY
# =============================================================================
# Tracks 6 macro events: CPI, PPI, NFP, FOMC, GDP, Retail Sales
# Measures the open-to-close return of the 1hr session window after each release
# CPI/PPI/NFP/GDP/Retail Sales: 8:30 AM ET release → 8:30–9:30 AM ET window
# FOMC: 2:00 PM ET release → 2:00–3:00 PM ET window
# =============================================================================

# === DATA SOURCE (1Min bars — base for intraday) ===
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1Min)()

# === CONTINUOUS CONTRACT (NoAdjustment for real price levels, LiquidityBased roll) ===
cont = futures_continuation(
    timeframe=1Min,
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardRatio,
    i_offset=0
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

open_p = cont.o
high_p = cont.h
low_p  = cont.l
close_p = cont.c

# =============================================================================
# ECONOMIC DATA (ALFRED vintage dates = actual release dates)
# =============================================================================

cpi_data    = economic_indicators(series_id='CPIAUCSL')()
ppi_data    = economic_indicators(series_id='PPIACO')()
nfp_data    = economic_indicators(series_id='PAYEMS')()
fomc_data   = economic_indicators(series_id='DFEDTARU')()
gdp_data    = economic_indicators(series_id='GDP')()
rsales_data = economic_indicators(series_id='RSAFS')()

# Cast to float (multiply by 1.0) then forward-fill indefinitely across all bars
cpi_filled    = ffill(cpi_data.result    * 1.0)
ppi_filled    = ffill(ppi_data.result    * 1.0)
nfp_filled    = ffill(nfp_data.result    * 1.0)
fomc_filled   = ffill(fomc_data.result   * 1.0)
gdp_filled    = ffill(gdp_data.result    * 1.0)
rsales_filled = ffill(rsales_data.result * 1.0)

# Detect release days: fires on any bar where the forward-filled value changes (new publication)
is_cpi_day    = cpi_filled    != (cpi_filled    >> 1)
is_ppi_day    = ppi_filled    != (ppi_filled    >> 1)
is_nfp_day    = nfp_filled    != (nfp_filled    >> 1)
is_fomc_day   = fomc_filled   != (fomc_filled   >> 1)
is_gdp_day    = gdp_filled    != (gdp_filled    >> 1)
is_rsales_day = rsales_filled != (rsales_filled >> 1)

# =============================================================================
# SESSION WINDOWS
# 8:30–9:30 AM ET: CPI, PPI, NFP, GDP, Retail Sales
# 2:00–3:00 PM ET: FOMC
# =============================================================================

w_830 = session_window(
    session=Session(start='08:30', end='09:30', tz='America/New_York')
)(open_p, high_p, low_p, close_p)

w_fomc = session_window(
    session=Session(start='14:00', end='15:00', tz='America/New_York')
)(open_p, high_p, low_p, close_p)

# =============================================================================
# RAW WINDOW RETURNS: (close - open) / open
# =============================================================================

r_830  = (w_830.close  - w_830.open)  / w_830.open
r_fomc = (w_fomc.close - w_fomc.open) / w_fomc.open

# =============================================================================
# PER-EVENT 1HR RETURNS (null on non-event bars; only when window closes)
# =============================================================================

r_cpi    = where(w_830.closed  and is_cpi_day,    r_830)
r_ppi    = where(w_830.closed  and is_ppi_day,    r_830)
r_nfp    = where(w_830.closed  and is_nfp_day,    r_830)
r_gdp    = where(w_830.closed  and is_gdp_day,    r_830)
r_rsales = where(w_830.closed  and is_rsales_day, r_830)
r_fomc_e = where(w_fomc.closed and is_fomc_day,   r_fomc)

# Absolute (magnitude) returns
abs_cpi    = abs(r_cpi)
abs_ppi    = abs(r_ppi)
abs_nfp    = abs(r_nfp)
abs_gdp    = abs(r_gdp)
abs_rsales = abs(r_rsales)
abs_fomc   = abs(r_fomc_e)

# Positive-direction flags (1 = up, 0 = down/flat)
up_cpi    = where(r_cpi    > 0, 1.0, 0.0)
up_ppi    = where(r_ppi    > 0, 1.0, 0.0)
up_nfp    = where(r_nfp    > 0, 1.0, 0.0)
up_gdp    = where(r_gdp    > 0, 1.0, 0.0)
up_rsales = where(r_rsales > 0, 1.0, 0.0)
up_fomc   = where(r_fomc_e > 0, 1.0, 0.0)

# Combined across all events (for overall headline cards)
all_event_return = coalesce(r_cpi, r_ppi, r_nfp, r_gdp, r_rsales, r_fomc_e)
all_event_up     = coalesce(up_cpi, up_ppi, up_nfp, up_gdp, up_rsales, up_fomc)
all_event_abs    = abs(all_event_return)

# Timestamp index (for scatter x-axis)
bar_ts = index()

# Snapshot timestamps only at event bars
ts_cpi    = where(w_830.closed  and is_cpi_day,    bar_ts)
ts_ppi    = where(w_830.closed  and is_ppi_day,    bar_ts)
ts_nfp    = where(w_830.closed  and is_nfp_day,    bar_ts)
ts_gdp    = where(w_830.closed  and is_gdp_day,    bar_ts)
ts_rsales = where(w_830.closed  and is_rsales_day, bar_ts)
ts_fomc   = where(w_fomc.closed and is_fomc_day,   bar_ts)

# =============================================================================
# SECTION 1: HEADLINE CARDS — Overall stats across all events
# =============================================================================

cards(
    layout=CardLayout(
        title='ES Futures: 1-Hour Post-Event Reaction (All Events)',
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Avg 1Hr Return (All Events)',  card_agg=AggregationType.Mean,   type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3, card_color_map={Color.Success: ['POSITIVE'], Color.Error: ['NEGATIVE']}),
            ColumnSpec(title='Median 1Hr Return (All Events)', card_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3, card_color_map={Color.Success: ['POSITIVE'], Color.Error: ['NEGATIVE']}),
            ColumnSpec(title='Win Rate (% Positive)',         card_agg=AggregationType.Mean,   type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title='Avg Absolute Move',             card_agg=AggregationType.Mean,   type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(title='Total Event Count',             card_agg=AggregationType.Count,  type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat)
        ]
    ),
    category='1. Overview'
)(all_event_return, all_event_return, all_event_up, all_event_abs, all_event_return)

# =============================================================================
# SECTION 2: SUMMARY TABLE — Per event type statistics (6 rows x 5 cols)
# =============================================================================

summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='1-Hour Post-Release Returns by Event Type',
        row_size=6,
        col_size=5,
        row_headers=['CPI', 'PPI', 'NFP', 'FOMC', 'GDP', 'Retail Sales'],
        col_headers=['Avg Return', 'Median Return', 'Win Rate', 'Avg |Move|', 'Count'],
        cells=[
            # CPI row (0)
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,   type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,   type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,   type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count,  type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            # PPI row (1)
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,   type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,   type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,   type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count,  type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            # NFP row (2)
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,   type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,   type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,   type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count,  type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            # FOMC row (3)
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,   type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,   type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,   type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count,  type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            # GDP row (4)
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,   type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,   type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,   type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count,  type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            # Retail Sales row (5)
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=5, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,   type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=5, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=5, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,   type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=5, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,   type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=5, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count,  type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat)
        ]
    ),
    category='2. By Event Type'
)(
    r_cpi, r_cpi, up_cpi, abs_cpi, r_cpi,
    r_ppi, r_ppi, up_ppi, abs_ppi, r_ppi,
    r_nfp, r_nfp, up_nfp, abs_nfp, r_nfp,
    r_fomc_e, r_fomc_e, up_fomc, abs_fomc, r_fomc_e,
    r_gdp, r_gdp, up_gdp, abs_gdp, r_gdp,
    r_rsales, r_rsales, up_rsales, abs_rsales, r_rsales
)

# =============================================================================
# SECTION 3: BAR CHART — Average 1hr return by event type (labeled mode)
# =============================================================================

xy_bars(
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    title='Average 1-Hour Return by Event Type',
    category='2. By Event Type',
    x_axis_label='Event Type',
    y_axis_label='Avg 1hr Return',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=3,
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='CPI',          color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='PPI',          color=Color.Teal),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='NFP',          color=Color.Green),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='FOMC',         color=Color.Purple),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='GDP',          color=Color.Orange),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Retail Sales', color=Color.Cyan)
    ])
)(r_cpi, r_ppi, r_nfp, r_fomc_e, r_gdp, r_rsales)

# Bar chart: Average absolute move by event type (volatility ranking)
xy_bars(
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    title='Average Absolute 1-Hour Move by Event Type',
    category='2. By Event Type',
    x_axis_label='Event Type',
    y_axis_label='Avg |Move|',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=3,
    data_labels=True,
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='CPI',          color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='PPI',          color=Color.Teal),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='NFP',          color=Color.Green),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='FOMC',         color=Color.Purple),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='GDP',          color=Color.Orange),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Retail Sales', color=Color.Cyan)
    ])
)(abs_cpi, abs_ppi, abs_nfp, abs_fomc, abs_gdp, abs_rsales)

# Bar chart: Win rate by event type
xy_bars(
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    title='Win Rate (% Positive 1hr) by Event Type',
    category='2. By Event Type',
    x_axis_label='Event Type',
    y_axis_label='Win Rate',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    data_labels=True,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.5, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='50%')
    ]),
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='CPI',          color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='PPI',          color=Color.Teal),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='NFP',          color=Color.Green),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='FOMC',         color=Color.Purple),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='GDP',          color=Color.Orange),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Retail Sales', color=Color.Cyan)
    ])
)(up_cpi, up_ppi, up_nfp, up_fomc, up_gdp, up_rsales)

# =============================================================================
# SECTION 4: SCATTER — Individual event moves over time, per event type
# =============================================================================

xy_lines(
    title='CPI Release: ES 1-Hour Returns Over Time',
    category='3. Individual Events',
    x_axis_label='Date',
    y_axis_label='1hr Return',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=3,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='CPI', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ])
)(ts_cpi, r_cpi)

xy_lines(
    title='PPI Release: ES 1-Hour Returns Over Time',
    category='3. Individual Events',
    x_axis_label='Date',
    y_axis_label='1hr Return',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=3,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='PPI', color=Color.Teal)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ])
)(ts_ppi, r_ppi)

xy_lines(
    title='NFP Release: ES 1-Hour Returns Over Time',
    category='3. Individual Events',
    x_axis_label='Date',
    y_axis_label='1hr Return',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=3,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='NFP', color=Color.Green)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ])
)(ts_nfp, r_nfp)

xy_lines(
    title='FOMC Decision: ES 1-Hour Returns Over Time',
    category='3. Individual Events',
    x_axis_label='Date',
    y_axis_label='1hr Return',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=3,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='FOMC', color=Color.Purple)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ])
)(ts_fomc, r_fomc_e)

xy_lines(
    title='GDP Release: ES 1-Hour Returns Over Time',
    category='3. Individual Events',
    x_axis_label='Date',
    y_axis_label='1hr Return',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=3,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='GDP', color=Color.Orange)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ])
)(ts_gdp, r_gdp)

xy_lines(
    title='Retail Sales Release: ES 1-Hour Returns Over Time',
    category='3. Individual Events',
    x_axis_label='Date',
    y_axis_label='1hr Return',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=3,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Retail Sales', color=Color.Cyan)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ])
)(ts_rsales, r_rsales)

# =============================================================================
# SECTION 5: DISTRIBUTIONS — Histograms of 1hr returns per event type
# =============================================================================

histogram(
    title='CPI: Distribution of 1-Hour Returns',
    category='4. Distributions',
    bins=25,
    fill_color=Color.Blue,
    fill_opacity=0.75,
    x_axis_label='1hr Return',
    x_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    show_analytics=True,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ])
)(r_cpi)

histogram(
    title='PPI: Distribution of 1-Hour Returns',
    category='4. Distributions',
    bins=25,
    fill_color=Color.Teal,
    fill_opacity=0.75,
    x_axis_label='1hr Return',
    x_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    show_analytics=True,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ])
)(r_ppi)

histogram(
    title='NFP: Distribution of 1-Hour Returns',
    category='4. Distributions',
    bins=25,
    fill_color=Color.Green,
    fill_opacity=0.75,
    x_axis_label='1hr Return',
    x_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    show_analytics=True,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ])
)(r_nfp)

histogram(
    title='FOMC: Distribution of 1-Hour Returns',
    category='4. Distributions',
    bins=25,
    fill_color=Color.Purple,
    fill_opacity=0.75,
    x_axis_label='1hr Return',
    x_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    show_analytics=True,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ])
)(r_fomc_e)

histogram(
    title='GDP: Distribution of 1-Hour Returns',
    category='4. Distributions',
    bins=20,
    fill_color=Color.Orange,
    fill_opacity=0.75,
    x_axis_label='1hr Return',
    x_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    show_analytics=True,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ])
)(r_gdp)

histogram(
    title='Retail Sales: Distribution of 1-Hour Returns',
    category='4. Distributions',
    bins=25,
    fill_color=Color.Cyan,
    fill_opacity=0.75,
    x_axis_label='1hr Return',
    x_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    show_analytics=True,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ])
)(r_rsales)
